avis.texte: I don’t believe I would be overstating my case to say I LOVE this product. I have serious rosacea problems, not the least of which are flaky, dry skin and the need for gentleness on my complexion. This unscrub takes care of both problems at once. I didn’t want to use a strong exfoliant all the time but felt like I needed something to remove all the dead skin resulting from the rosacea aftermath. This wonderful unscrub has little beads in it like a scrub but, as you’re working it into your skin, you realize the beads are dissolving and it cleans your face and moisturizes at the same time. I plan to continue using this “tube of miracles “ as long as it’s available.

I have sensitive skin but ever since accutane it’s not been as severe however I get awful dry patches on my face that need a good exfoliant to cleanse the dead skin away. This product is good but still want to search. It’s almost too gentle. The beads in it are large but roll around with no roughness to them to exfoliate much. I do think it has removed some of the dry skin after cleaning without being to harsh, no raw red skin after. However I wish it had just a little more grit to it. Overall decent but not as expected. My skin is glowy and not irritated after thought which is a plus. No bad reactions

I have very sensitive skin, so I’m always wary of what I put on my face. I had heard great things about Paula’s Choice, so I decided to give The Unscrub a try. I’m so glad I did! The beads provide enough exfoliation while still being gentle enough for my skin! A little goes a long way, so it takes months before I need to repurchase!
I have used this scrub for years. Nicely polishes my face without irritation. Gentle and has no fragrances. After use I notice my makeup glides on easily and smoothly.
I've been using it about a month and I noticed a significant decrease in blackheads and my pores aren't nearly as visible
This is the best face scrub if you're on actives. It won't irritate your skin but helps get dead skin off. Highly recommend if you're on tret, accutane, AHAs/BHAs etc.

There are not enough little pellets in the formula to feel like I'm adequately exfoliating my face. Also, the product leaves a film a caused me to break out just a little. I prefer to use a stronger cleanser for my aging skin followed up with a good moisturizer.
